title: SEC EDGAR (research)
description: SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) from EDGAR's full-text search as a research source on financial topics, through gohort's built-in EDGAR search, which takes out the field tags EDGAR cannot read. Free, no key.
setup_notes: No key needed. The SEC asks callers to name themselves: the deployment's mail From address goes in the User-Agent. It searches filings from the start of two years ago to today. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: financial, economic, corporate, investment), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
